title.narrative: Strategic support to Uganda as it Co-Chairs the Coalition of Finance Ministers for Climate Action

description.narrative: The objective of this development cooperation is to advance adaptation and climate resilience in African and developing member countries of the Coalition of Finance Ministers for Climate Action. This is accomplished by supporting the Government of Uganda as it co-chairs the Coalition, helping the country to raise awareness on climate risks and building the capacities of Ministries of Finance in Africa to model and integrate climate risks in their policy and financial planning.

Uganda will be co-chair of the Coalition of Finance Ministers for Climate Action for the 2-year period covering from April 1st 2025, to 31st March 2027. Under this project, GGGI will (a) provide strategic advice to the Ministry of Finance of Uganda to identify and propose top-level outcomes to pursue through the Coalition, (b) work with the Ministry of Finance to define and operationalise concrete actions. GGGI will provide technical assistance to design and implement dialogues and trainings and will identify and facilitate the participation of key experts from governments, academia, the private sector, NGOs and IGOs, including its own experts. GGGI will leverage its extensive experience supporting green finance mobilization to bring knowledge on innovative financial instruments and carbon markets to support finance mobilization through the Coalition members.
